title: Nick Sirianni on Lane Johnson: He's dealing with a personal matter, that's all I'll say

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni on Lane Johnson: He's dealing with a personal matter, that's all I'll say
sources.description: Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson was an unexpected scratch from the lineup on Sunday and head coach Nick Sirianni didn't shed any light about his outlook moving forward during a press conference after a 24-20 loss to the Rams.
